+"""Standalone copy of ``_pytest._io.saferepr._format_repr_exception``.
+
+This module is importable by file path without importing ``_pytest``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_repr_exception", "vendored_repr_exception_variant"]
+
+
+def _try_repr_or_str(obj: object) -> str:
+    try:
+        return repr(obj)
+    except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit):
+        raise
+    except BaseException:
+        return f'{type(obj).__name__}("{obj}")'
+
+
+def vendored_repr_exception(exc: BaseException, obj: object) -> str:
+    try:
+        exc_info = _try_repr_or_str(exc)
+    except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit):
+        raise
+    except BaseException as inner_exc:
+        exc_info = f"unpresentable exception ({_try_repr_or_str(inner_exc)})"
+    return (
+        f"<[{exc_info} raised in repr()] {type(obj).__name__} object at 0x{id(obj):x}>"
+    )
+
+
+def vendored_repr_exception_variant(exc: BaseException, obj: object) -> str:
+    """Like :func:`vendored_repr_exception`, with a trailing newline appended."""
+    return vendored_repr_exception(exc, obj) + "\n"

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+from types import ModuleType
+
+import pytest
+
+
+MODULE_PATH = Path(__file__).parents[2] / "src" / "standalone_wave6_repr_exception.py"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def mod() -> ModuleType:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "_standalone_wave6_repr_exception_under_test", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+class Obj:
+    pass
+
+
+class BrokenReprExc(Exception):
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        raise ValueError("bad repr")
+
+
+class BrokenEverything(Exception):
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        raise self
+
+    def __str__(self) -> str:
+        raise ValueError("bad str")
+
+
+def test_no_pytest_dependency() -> None:
+    source = MODULE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "_pytest" not in source.replace(
+        "``_pytest._io.saferepr._format_repr_exception``", ""
+    ).replace("``_pytest``", "")
+
+
+def test_exports(mod: ModuleType) -> None:
+    assert set(mod.__all__) == {
+        "vendored_repr_exception",
+        "vendored_repr_exception_variant",
+    }
+
+
+def test_normal(mod: ModuleType) -> None:
+    obj = Obj()
+    result = mod.vendored_repr_exception(ValueError("boom"), obj)
+    assert result == (
+        f"<[ValueError('boom') raised in repr()] Obj object at 0x{id(obj):x}>"
+    )
+
+
+def test_empty_message(mod: ModuleType) -> None:
+    obj = Obj()
+    result = mod.vendored_repr_exception(Exception(), obj)
+    assert result == f"<[Exception() raised in repr()] Obj object at 0x{id(obj):x}>"
+
+
+def test_exception_with_broken_repr_falls_back_to_str(mod: ModuleType) -> None:
+    obj = Obj()
+    result = mod.vendored_repr_exception(BrokenReprExc("msg"), obj)
+    assert result.startswith('<[BrokenReprExc("msg") raised in repr()] Obj')
+
+
+def test_unpresentable_exception(mod: ModuleType) -> None:
+    obj = Obj()
+    result = mod.vendored_repr_exception(BrokenEverything(), obj)
+    assert result.startswith("<[unpresentable exception (")
+    assert result.endswith(f"raised in repr()] Obj object at 0x{id(obj):x}>")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("exc_type", [KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit])
+def test_propagates_fatal(mod: ModuleType, exc_type: type[BaseException]) -> None:
+    class Fatal(Exception):
+        def __repr__(self) -> str:
+            raise exc_type()
+
+    with pytest.raises(exc_type):
+        mod.vendored_repr_exception(Fatal(), Obj())
+    with pytest.raises(exc_type):
+        mod.vendored_repr_exception_variant(Fatal(), Obj())
+
+
+def test_matches_original(mod: ModuleType) -> None:
+    from _pytest._io.saferepr import _format_repr_exception
+
+    obj = Obj()
+    for exc in (ValueError("x"), Exception(), BrokenReprExc("m"), BrokenEverything()):
+        assert mod.vendored_repr_exception(exc, obj) == _format_repr_exception(exc, obj)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "exc", [ValueError("boom"), Exception(), BrokenReprExc(), BrokenEverything()]
+)
+def test_variant_appends_single_newline(mod: ModuleType, exc: BaseException) -> None:
+    obj = Obj()
+    base = mod.vendored_repr_exception(exc, obj)
+    result = mod.vendored_repr_exception_variant(exc, obj)
+    assert result == base + "\n"
+    assert not result.endswith("\n\n")
+
+
+def test_import_does_not_load_pytest_saferepr() -> None:
+    code = (
+        "import importlib.util, sys;"
+        f"spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', {str(MODULE_PATH)!r});"
+        "m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m);"
+        "assert '_pytest' not in sys.modules, sorted(sys.modules)"
+    )
+    import subprocess
+
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], check=True)
notes:
Copied _format_repr_exception verbatim as vendored_repr_exception plus _try_repr_or_str into a pytest-free module, with vendored_repr_exception_variant appending one newline; tests load the module by file path, check parity with the original, fallback/unpresentable/empty cases, KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit propagation, and that importing it does not load _pytest.
